reserveReview.rationale: The August 2026 ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance examination reports 1,800,903.74 MYRC in circulation and MYR 1,800,903.74 of reserve assets in its assertion. Its itemized breakdown states MYR 1,200,903.77 cash (66.68%) and MYR 600,000.00 Halogen Shariah MYR Liquid Fund (33.32%), totaling MYR 1,800,903.77. The MYR 0.03 difference between the assertion and breakdown is retained explicitly rather than silently reconciled. The report is signed 2026-09-29 and the archive lists an upload on 2026-09-30; neither is treated as a separately stated publication date. Named banks, provider shares and account safeguards remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Published allocation percentages in the Tommy Ung & Partners PLT August 2026 reserve examination
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The August 2026 examination identifies 66.68% MYR cash/bank deposits and 33.32% Halogen Shariah MYR Liquid Fund, but bank identities, provider shares, account segregation and legal terms remain undisclosed. nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The August 2026 examination identifies MYR cash at banks; fiat cash is an exogenous reserve rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
The Halogen Shariah MYR Liquid Fund is a Securities Commission Malaysia-licensed money-market fund, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
